description: Subscribe the user to TakeMeUp's weekly email of job openings that match one of their CVs. PRO. Use when the user wants job alerts by email. Returns {ok, subscribed, cvId} or 403 pro_required.

cvId.description: Optional — defaults to the most recent CV.

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: subscribe_takemeup_job_alerts
title: Subscribe to weekly job alerts (PRO)
